blocks.prompt: 9 A fully insulated battery overheats during operation and reaches 80 °C. After shutdown, it begins to cool without any external influence. If it cools to 50 °C in 2 hours, how long will it take to cool to 15 °C?
blocks.explanation:
Yeh cooling ka sawal hai, lekin is mein kamre (surroundings) ka temperature diya hi nahi gaya; sawal kehta hai 'baghair kisi bairooni asar ke'.
Is liye hum thanda hone ki raftar ko seedha temperature ke proportional lete hain: \(\frac{dT}{dt} = -kT\). Yeh Newton's law hai jis mein \(T_S = 0\)°C maan liya gaya hai; answer key bhi yahi maanti hai.
Diya kya hai? \(T(0) = 80\), \(T(2) = 50\).
Find kya karna hai? Woh waqt jab \(T = 15\).
Plan: hal karein, \(k\) nikalein, phir \(T = 15\) rakh kar \(t\) nikalein.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(T(0) = 80\)°C, \(T(2) = 50\)°C; \(t\) ghanton mein.
Maloom karna: woh waqt \(t\) jab \(T = 15\)°C ho.
Tareeqa: \(\frac{dT}{dt} = -kT\), \(k > 0\) (surroundings ka asar nazar andaz); yeh separable hai.

Differential equation hal karein
\[\int\dfrac{dT}{T} = -k\int dt\]
\[\ln|T| = -kt + C\]
\[T(0) = 80 \Rightarrow C = \ln 80\]
\[T = 80e^{-kt}\]
Kyun: variables alag kar ke integrate kiya, pehli condition se \(C = \ln 80\) mila, phir \(\ln|T| - \ln 80 = -kt\) se \(e\) liya. Yeh bilkul radioactive decay jaisa model hai.

\(T(2) = 50\) lagayein
\[50 = 80e^{-2k}\]
\[e^{-2k} = \dfrac{5}{8}\]
\[k = \tfrac{1}{2}\ln\tfrac{8}{5} \approx 0.2350\]
Kyun: 80 se divide kiya, phir \(\ln\) liya; \(-\ln\frac{5}{8} = \ln\frac{8}{5} \approx 0.470004\). Yeh \(k\) fi ghanta hai.

\(T = 15\) rakhein
\[15 = 80e^{-kt}\]
\[e^{-kt} = \dfrac{15}{80} = \dfrac{3}{16}\]
\[kt = \ln\dfrac{16}{3}\]
Kyun: 80 se divide kiya aur fraction ko simplify kiya, phir \(\ln\) liya; minus ulta karne se \(\frac{16}{3}\) aaya.

\(t\) nikalein
\[t = \dfrac{2\ln(16/3)}{\ln(8/5)}\]
\[\approx \dfrac{2(1.673976)}{0.470004}\]
\[\approx 7.12\]
Kyun: \(k = \frac{1}{2}\ln\frac{8}{5}\) se divide kiya; 2 upar chala gaya. Round sirf aakhir mein kiya.
Dhyan dein: 7.12 ghante shutdown se hain; 50°C ke baad mazeed waqt 7.12 - 2 = 5.12 ghante hai.

Tasdeeq
\[80e^{-0.2350(7.12)} \approx 80e^{-1.674} \approx 80(0.1875) = 15 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: hamare waqt par temperature sach mein 15°C aata hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Sawal mein surroundings ka temperature nahi diya gaya, aur 'fully insulated' battery to garmi kho hi nahi sakti. Agar kamra \(T_S \ge 15\)°C ho to Newton's law ke mutabiq battery kabhi 15°C tak nahi pohanchegi. Answer key ka 7.12 ghante wala jawab \(\frac{dT}{dt} = -kT\) se aata hai, yani surroundings 0°C maan kar; sawal mein yeh baat likhi honi chahiye thi.
